peopleAlsoAsk.question: Why is biochar not widely used?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Biochar has various potential environmental risks in soil, water, and atmosphere. Feedstocks, production process, and application affect the ecotoxicity of biochar. The harmful components in biochar have potential environmental risks. The size and structure of biochar itself have potential environmental risks.
peopleAlsoAsk.title: The negative environmental impacts of biochar applications

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Can you put too much biochar in soil?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: There is no benefit in applying more biochar than necessary. Adding too much does not further boost soil productivity. Once applied, it remains in the soil for centuries. Additionally, there are risks associated with over-application.
peopleAlsoAsk.title: How Much Biochar Should You Add to Soil?
